# P31.2 (HARDEN.2): ingest-run completion + real freshness

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.2__ingest-run-completion-and-freshness.md` (Round 9 Wave A, manifest row 143). It
closes the **engine half of D-P30.3-1**: every hosted `ingest_run` was `running` with `finished_at` NULL, so every
source showed `not-recorded` on the freshness page. It stacks on P31.1 (`devin/p31-1-api-db-resilience-and-bounded-search`).

**Gate Q3 (ratified 2026-09-24): no standalone republish.** Completions are recorded and backfilled on the hosted
spine, and freshness is proven from the export path read-only. The public site was not rebuilt or re-synced. It
still honestly shows `not-recorded` until the single P31.16 republish.

## Summary

- **Each execution gets its own `ingest_run`** (ADR-109). Each `PgClaimSink` carries an `execution_id` (generated,
  or passed explicitly to resume a run, the hook P31.4 needs) in `ingest_run.parameters`. The old reuse-by-key,
  which folded more than 250 `dot_511` executions into one row, is gone.
- **Completion is an appended row.** A new sqitch change, `ingest_run_completion`, adds:
  - a status: `ok` / `partial` / `quota_reached` / `failed`;
  - a DB-clock `finished_at`, the counts, and the WORM run-row URI;
  - an immutability trigger;
  - one live completion per run and one backfilled row per `gs://` object, so every write is `ON CONFLICT DO
    NOTHING`.

  **`ingest_run` is never updated.**
- **Every live execution records how it ended.** `connectors.pipeline.run` records the status on success and
  `failed` (exception class only) on failure. Gate refusals, replays and shadow runs record nothing, and a
  completion that cannot be written never masks the run. `scheduled-ingest` computes the WORM run-row URI in
  advance, so the run row and the completion name each other; the run row gains `ingest_run_id`.
- **WORM backfill.** `sig-ops backfill-run-completions` runs as `materialize.sh run run-completions`, as
  `sig_materialize` with INSERT only. Its deterministic matching appends completions only where claims in the
  row's window, or a sole candidate run, prove the run. Every other row is reported unmatched with its reason,
  and a re-run is +0.
- **Freshness reads completions:**
  - `last_successful_run` comes from ok/partial/quota_reached completions;
  - `last_content_change` comes only from completions that **inserted > 0 claims**;
  - `status` is the latest completion's status.

  The legacy values stay the fallback.

## What changed

- `db/deploy|revert|verify/ingest_run_completion.sql`, `db/sqitch.plan`
- `db/src/db/run_completion.py` (new): the single INSERT and the status vocabulary
- `db/src/db/claim_sink.py`:
  - per-execution run;
  - `record_completion`;
  - `run_id`;
  - a chunk that raises now restores the cached ids and the committed counters.
- `connectors/src/connectors/{pipeline,stages,runner}.py`: the `CompletionRecorder` protocol, `completion_status`,
  `run_record_uri` passthrough, `SourceRunReport.run_id`
- `ops/src/ops/{scheduled,cli,run_completion}.py`: `run_object_uri`, `RunRow.ingest_run_id`, the backfill verb
- `ops/gcp/materialize.sh`: the `run-completions` step (not part of `all`)
- `ops/Dockerfile`: installs **with constraints exported from `uv.lock`**. The first hosted build failed when an
  unconstrained resolve picked the just-released `sqlalchemy 2.1.0`, whose sdist uv rejects.
- `exports/src/exports/shaping.py`: the per-source completion read and merge
- ADR-109, its Appendix F row (spec rebuilt), the ADR index, BL-056 → ADR-109, DEFERRALS, and the run ledger

## Verification

- **Local:**
  - `make check` exit 0;
  - `make test-db` 216 passed;
  - `tests/e2e` 16 passed;
  - sqitch deploy → revert → redeploy drill;
  - `check-build-memory.sh .` (only the existing BM-ADR-04 warning), `check_backlog.py`,
    `build_backlog_md.py --check`, `check_spec_src.py` (677 ids) and `test_policy_adrs.py` all green.
- **Independent fresh-context review:** three should-fix findings, all fixed with tests:
  - a stale run id after a chunk rolled back;
  - overlap detection missing nested windows;
  - a count that could include a claim twice (now DISTINCT).
- **Hosted:**
  - schema deployed (additive; no Cloud SQL restart; `sig-api` untouched on `sha256:21bb9526…`);
  - image `sig-api:materialize-d6ecb70ada20` = `sha256:9f8f19ae…`, with `:latest` unmoved;
  - backfill and its +0 re-run;
  - read-only shape before and after;
  - `probe-hosted` 8/8;
  - the public page still shows `not-recorded`, as intended.

## Design decisions / deviations

- `partial` and `quota_reached` count as successful runs for freshness but map to `degraded` status. `failed`
  maps to `failing`.
- Each execution now writes its own synthetic capture and extraction per `(source, genre)`. Claims still
  de-duplicate.
- The scheduled ingest jobs record completions only after P31.4 rolls them by pinned digest. Until then,
  freshness advances only by re-running the backfill.
